parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Boost for exporters

  • Two pilots started under the Niryat Protsahan arm of the Export Promotion Mission: an interest subvention of 2.75% on pre- and post-shipment export credit (up to Rs 50 lakh per exporter in 2025-26) and collateral support with CGTMSE.
  • Collateral guarantee cover: up to 85% for micro and small exporters, 65% for medium; cap Rs 10 crore per exporter a year.
  • Market Access Support (MAS) launched under Niryat Disha: buyer-seller meets, trade fairs and delegations, with at least 35% MSME participation.
  • NITI Aayog's Export Preparedness Index 4.0: Maharashtra 1st, Tamil Nadu 2nd, Gujarat 3rd among large states; Uttarakhand tops small, NE states and UTs.
  • RBI notified new FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026, effective October 2026: export proceeds to be realised within 15 months (18 months for rupee deals).
Export Promotion Mission (EPM): approved 12 November 2025; outlay Rs 25,060 crore for 2025-26 to 2030-31; run by DGFT; two sub-schemes – Niryat Protsahan and Niryat Disha.

Schemes extended or reshaped

  • Cabinet extended Atal Pension Yojana till 2030-31; it gives a guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000–5,000 a month after 60 to non-taxpayers who join between 18 and 40.
  • Over 10,000 km of rural roads cleared under PMGSY-IV (2024-25 to 2028-29: 62,500 km, 25,000 habitations, outlay Rs 70,125 crore).
  • District-Led Textile Transformation (DLTT): 100 high-potential districts to become 'Global Export Champions' and 100 aspirational districts 'Self-Reliant Hubs'.
  • Five more firms picked under PLI for White Goods (AC components), committing Rs 863 crore; total now 85 firms.
  • Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and Sukanya Samriddhi turned 11 (both launched 22 January 2015, Panipat). SSY now pays 8.2%; account for a girl under 10, Rs 250 to Rs 1.5 lakh a year, matures at 21.
  • GeM's 'Womaniya' (2019): over 2 lakh women-led MSEs registered; 4.7% of GeM order value against a 3% target.
  • National Entrepreneurship Mission under DAY-NRLM (12 January): train 50,000 community resource persons and 50 lakh SHG members.
  • PM Vishwakarma Haat held in New Delhi, 18–31 January.
  • Food Ministry's 'Ann Chakra' (PDS route optimisation by C-DAC with WFP and IIT Delhi) is a finalist for the Franz Edelman Award 2026.
Atal Pension Yojana: launched 2015, regulated by PFRDA; pension depends on the subscriber's contribution.
PMGSY: centrally sponsored rural roads scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development, launched 25 December 2000.

Banks, regulators and finance

  • Cabinet approved Rs 5,000 crore equity for SIDBI in three tranches (Rs 3,000 cr in 2025-26, then Rs 1,000 cr twice).
  • RBI's new Payments Regulatory Board (PRB) held its first meeting under Governor Sanjay Malhotra; set up under the PSS Act, 2007, it replaced the BPSS and has 6 members.
  • PFRDA formed a 16-member panel under Dr M.S. Sahoo to frame an assured-payout framework under NPS.
  • Sagarmala Finance Corporation is India's first NBFC focused on maritime lending.
  • Forex reserves hit a record of about US$709 billion (RBI data, 23 January).
  • A comprehensive AYUSH Mediclaim policy launched for CGHS beneficiaries (cover of Rs 10 or 20 lakh, up to six members).
SIDBI: set up in 1990 under the SIDBI Act, 1989; headquarters Lucknow; main lender for MSMEs.

Resources, power and the blue economy

  • Coking coal notified as a critical and strategic mineral under the MMDR Act, 1957; about 95% of the steel sector's need is imported; reserves mainly in Jharkhand.
  • India's transmission grid crossed 5 lakh circuit km (220 kV and above) on 14 January with the 765 kV Bhadla-II–Sikar-II line.
  • India overtook China as the world's largest rice producer (about 150 million tonnes); Uttar Pradesh is the top state.
  • India's first all-electric tug, built by Atreya Shipyard (Goa) for Deendayal Port, Kandla, under the Green Tug Transition Programme (50 green tugs by 2030).
  • India's first open-sea marine fish farming pilot started at Sri Vijayapuram (Andaman) by NIOT.
  • A Rs 200 crore smart fishing harbour approved at Mayabunder (Andaman) under PM Matsya Sampada Yojana.

Reports and corporate deals

  • CAG State Finances report 2023-24: states' debt about 23% of GSDP; 18 states crossed the 3% fiscal deficit limit.
  • NITI Aayog released decarbonisation roadmaps for cement and aluminium, and a green-transition roadmap for MSMEs (MSMEs give ~30% of GDP and ~46% of exports).
  • Brand Finance IT Services 25: Accenture 1st, TCS 2nd, Infosys 3rd. In the Global 500, Apple is 1st and Tata Group (61st) is the top Indian brand.
  • HAL and Russia's United Aircraft Corporation agreed to make the SJ-100 regional jet in India; Adani tied up with Brazil's Embraer for regional aircraft.
  • MoSPI unveiled a new logo with the message 'Data for Development'.
